image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a vintage black typewriter. The focus is on the keyboard area, featuring round, glass-topped keys with white lettering arranged in rows. At the bottom center, there is a long, narrow, rectangular metal bar (the space bar) that contrasts with the round keys above it. The machine has a glossy black finish with visible mechanical linkages and a paper carriage at the top.

The reflections on the black glossy surface are slightly inconsistent and 'smudged,' lacking the precise environmental mapping expected from a hard, glossy surface. It has a slight digital painting look.

The mechanical linkages connecting the round keys to the base are vague and lack distinct geometric clarity. They appear as blurry dark shapes rather than precise mechanical parts, suggesting a failure to render complex small-scale geometry.
